# Third-party dependencies. Everything is either fetched at configure time
# (pinned tags) or vendored (glad). Warnings are never enabled for these.
include(FetchContent)

# --- client-only: SDL3, glad, ImGui, miniaudio -----------------------------
# Skipped entirely when FPS_BUILD_CLIENT=OFF (a dedicated-server build). SDL3
# in particular is not merely unused there: its CMake hard-errors on a host
# with no X11/Wayland development libraries, so fetching it would break a
# headless build that never links it.
if(FPS_BUILD_CLIENT)

# --- SDL3 (window, GL context, input) -------------------------------------
set(SDL_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_TEST_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(SDL_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(
    SDL3
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL.git
    GIT_TAG release-3.2.16
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    SYSTEM
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(SDL3)

# --- glad (OpenGL 4.1 core loader, vendored: generated by glad2) ----------
add_library(glad STATIC glad/src/gl.c)
target_include_directories(glad SYSTEM PUBLIC glad/include)

endif()  # FPS_BUILD_CLIENT (SDL3 + glad)

# --- GLM (math) ------------------------------------------------------------
FetchContent_Declare(
    glm
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/g-truc/glm.git
    GIT_TAG 1.0.1
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    SYSTEM
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(glm)

if(FPS_BUILD_CLIENT)
# --- Dear ImGui (debug UI; no CMakeLists upstream, we define the target) ---
FetchContent_Declare(
    imgui
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git
    GIT_TAG v1.91.8
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(imgui)
add_library(imgui STATIC
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_draw.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_tables.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_widgets.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/imgui_demo.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_sdl3.cpp
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends/imgui_impl_opengl3.cpp
)
target_include_directories(imgui SYSTEM PUBLIC
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${imgui_SOURCE_DIR}/backends
)
target_link_libraries(imgui PUBLIC SDL3::SDL3)
endif()  # FPS_BUILD_CLIENT (ImGui)

# --- cgltf (glTF 2.0 parser, header-only) ----------------------------------
FetchContent_Declare(
    cgltf
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf.git
    GIT_TAG v1.14
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(cgltf)
add_library(cgltf INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(cgltf SYSTEM INTERFACE ${cgltf_SOURCE_DIR})

# --- stb_image (PNG/JPG decoding for glTF textures) ------------------------
FetchContent_Declare(
    stb
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/nothings/stb.git
    GIT_TAG f0569113c93ad095470c54bf34a17b36646bbbb5
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(stb)
add_library(stb INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(stb SYSTEM INTERFACE ${stb_SOURCE_DIR})

# --- ENet (UDP transport with optional reliability) -------------------------
FetchContent_Declare(
    enet
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/lsalzman/enet.git
    GIT_TAG v1.3.18
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    SYSTEM
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(enet)
target_include_directories(enet SYSTEM PUBLIC ${enet_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(enet PUBLIC winmm ws2_32)
endif()

# --- miniaudio (audio playback, header-only) --------------------------------
if(FPS_BUILD_CLIENT)
FetchContent_Declare(
    miniaudio
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio.git
    GIT_TAG 0.11.21
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(miniaudio)
add_library(miniaudio INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(miniaudio SYSTEM INTERFACE ${miniaudio_SOURCE_DIR})
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(miniaudio INTERFACE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} pthread m)
endif()
endif()  # FPS_BUILD_CLIENT (miniaudio)

# --- Jolt Physics -----------------------------------------------------------
set(TARGET_UNIT_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_HELLO_WORLD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_PERFORMANCE_TEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_SAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(TARGET_VIEWER OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_ALL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(INTERPROCEDURAL_OPTIMIZATION OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Jolt defaults to the static MSVC CRT (/MT); everything else here uses the
# dynamic CRT, and mixing them is a link error.
set(USE_STATIC_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Jolt disables RTTI by default; our translation units compile with RTTI and
# reference typeinfo for Jolt classes they derive/instantiate - keep ABI
# consistent or GNU ld fails with "undefined reference to typeinfo".
set(CPP_RTTI_ENABLED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPP_EXCEPTIONS_ENABLED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# SYSTEM (CMake >= 3.25): consumers see Jolt/glm headers as system includes,
# so our warnings-as-errors never fires inside them (Jolt trips
# -Wdouble-promotion, glm trips -Wsign-conversion on some compilers).
FetchContent_Declare(
    JoltPhysics
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/jrouwe/JoltPhysics.git
    GIT_TAG v5.2.0
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
    SOURCE_SUBDIR Build
    SYSTEM
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(JoltPhysics)

# --- libdatachannel (WebRTC DataChannel transport, optional) ----------------
# Only fetched when FPS_ENABLE_WEBRTC is on: it is a much heavier dependency
# than anything else here (five submodules plus a TLS backend), and the
# WebSocket transport already serves browsers.
if(FPS_ENABLE_WEBRTC)
    # We do our own signalling over the existing WebSocket transport, and the
    # game sends no audio or video, so both of those subsystems are off. That
    # drops libsrtp and the media stack entirely.
    set(NO_MEDIA ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(NO_WEBSOCKET ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(NO_EXAMPLES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(NO_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    # One of libdatachannel's submodules (plog) still declares a CMake
    # minimum below 3.5, which CMake 4 refuses outright. This relaxes the
    # floor for the subtree; it is scoped to this block and restored after.
    set(_fps_saved_policy_min "${CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM}")
    set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    FetchContent_Declare(
        libdatachannel
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/paullouisageneau/libdatachannel.git
        GIT_TAG v0.22.4
        GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
        GIT_SUBMODULES_RECURSE TRUE
        SYSTEM
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(libdatachannel)
    set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM "${_fps_saved_policy_min}" CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()
